report.requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data
report.evidence: WhatsApp LLC provides our Services to you under this Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
report.reason: The policy clearly states the identity of the controller.

report.requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
report.condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
report.reason: The policy does not mention any contact details for a Data Protection Officer.

report.requirement: The personal data that is collected
report.evidence: you must provide your mobile phone number and basic information (including a profile name of your choice) to create a WhatsApp account.
report.reason: The policy specifies the personal data that is collected.

report.requirement: The means used to collect personal data
report.evidence: WhatsApp must receive or collect some information to operate, provide, improve, understand, customize, support, and market our Services.
report.reason: The policy describes the means used to collect personal data.

report.requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
report.evidence: We use information we have to operate, provide, improve, understand, customize, support, and market our Services.
report.reason: The policy clearly states the purpose of collecting and processing personal data.

report.requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
report.evidence: We require certain information to deliver our Services and without this we will not be able to provide our Services to you.
report.reason: The policy mentions the necessity of providing information but does not specify the legal basis.

report.requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
report.evidence: you must provide your mobile phone number to create an account to use our Services.
report.reason: The policy clearly states which personal data is mandatory.

report.requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
report.evidence: If you don’t provide us with this information, you will not be able to create an account to use our Services.
report.reason: The policy clearly outlines the consequences of not providing personal data.

report.requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
report.evidence: Businesses you interact with using our Services may provide us with information about their interactions with you.
report.reason: The policy mentions sharing with businesses but does not detail all parties involved.

report.requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
report.evidence: Your information may, for example, be transferred or transmitted to, or stored and processed in, the United States.
report.reason: The policy clearly states that personal data may be processed outside the Kingdom.

report.requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
report.evidence: We store information for as long as necessary for the purposes identified in this Privacy Policy
report.reason: The policy mentions data retention but lacks specific timeframes.

report.requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
report.reason: The policy does not address how personal data is stored and destroyed.

report.requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
report.evidence: you can delete your WhatsApp account at any time
report.reason: The policy mentions some rights but does not cover all specified rights.

report.requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
report.evidence: You can access or port your information using our in-app Request Account Info feature
report.reason: The policy provides some information on exercising rights but lacks comprehensive details.

report.evidence: you can delete your WhatsApp account at any time (including if you want to revoke your consent)
report.reason: The policy mentions withdrawal of consent but does not provide a clear process.

report.requirement: The measures taken to protect personal data
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.evidence: we take to protect your privacy, like building our Services so delivered messages aren’t stored by us
report.reason: The policy clearly states measures taken to protect personal data.

report.requirement: Whether decisions are made solely by automated processing
report.condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
report.reason: The policy does not mention automated processing for decision-making.
